headings.notes: Unbounded is a distinctive, wide geometric font that supports Cyrillic beautifully. It bridges the 'Web3/Tech' concept with playful, approachable geometry perfect for kids and parents. Never use Inter for headings.

body.notes: Crisp, highly readable, and trustworthy. Excellent Cyrillic support. Use for all paragraphs, forms, and UI text.

rules.contrast: Always ensure text on accent colors has sufficient contrast (e.g., text-stone-900 on bg-amber-100).
rules.dark_mode: For this specific educational landing page targeting parents, LIGHT THEME ONLY is preferred to convey safety, transparency, and a 'classroom' feel.

visual_enhancers.corners: rounded-[2rem] or rounded-[3rem] for main bento cards and hero images. rounded-full for buttons and badges.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-stone-200 for definition on light cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient, diffuse shadows only (e.g., shadow-xl shadow-orange-500/10) for CTAs. No harsh drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain overlay (bg-noise) on the hero section to make it feel tactile (like a Montessori classroom).
visual_enhancers.marquee: Use a slow-moving editorial ribbon with tech/learning keywords (e.g., 'Bitcoin • Lightning • Финансовая грамотность • Безопасность') separated by stars/dots, placed between sections.

grids_and_layouts.hero: Two-column asymmetrical. Left: 60% width with H1, Subtext, CTAs, and trust badges. Right: 40% width with the floating 'Satoshi' robot mascot or kids learning image. Huge padding (py-24 or py-32).
grids_and_layouts.bento_benefits: Mode A 'Tetris' Grid. 12-column grid. Mix spanning (e.g., one large card spanning 8 cols, two smaller cards spanning 4 cols). Use different accent background colors (bg-amber-100, bg-sky-100) for each bento card.
grids_and_layouts.timeline_syllabus: Vertical layout. Use customized Shadcn Accordion for the 10-week program so parents can expand to read details. Generous padding inside accordion content.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Exaggerated spacing. gap-8 to gap-12 in grids. py-24 between major sections.

component_patterns.cta_buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Massive hit area (px-8 py-4, text-lg). Energetic hover state (-translate-y-1, shadow-lg).
component_patterns.cards: Flat background, soft large radius (rounded-3xl), 1px border, massive internal padding (p-8 to p-12).
component_patterns.lead_form: Minimal, high-trust. Input fields should be large (h-14, rounded-2xl, bg-stone-100, border-none). Wrap in a pristine white card with soft shadow.
component_patterns.icons: Use Lucide-React. Scale them up (w-10 h-10 or w-12 h-12) and place them in rounded-full soft-colored wrappers (e.g., bg-orange-100 text-orange-600).

motion.hero_mascot: Slow, continuous floating effect using y: [0, -15, 0] with a duration of 4s easeInOut loop.
motion.scroll_reveal: Staggered fade-up for Bento Grid items and Timeline items (initial opacity-0, y-10).
motion.hover_states: Cards should have a subtle scale-up (scale: 1.02) and button lifts (-translate-y-1).

image_urls.description: Cute yellow 3D robot 'Satoshi' mascot on orange background. Use in Hero section or alongside the lead form.
Happy kid using a tablet. Good for 'Format' or secondary hero visual.
Father and son studying together. Use in the FAQ or Trust/Parent section.
Child putting coin into a sleek blue piggy bank. Great for the 'Financial Literacy' bento card.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over accent backgrounds (like bg-orange-500) is pure white or near-black for APCA/WCAG AA compliance.
accessibility.touch_targets: All buttons, accordion headers, and form inputs must be at least 44px (h-11) tall.
accessibility.focus: Use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500 focus:ring-offset-2 on all interactive elements.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add data-testid to every CTA, form input, and accordion trigger (e.g., data-testid='enroll-button', data-testid='faq-trigger-1').

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-converting kids education landing page for parents in Russian. The tone is trustworthy, modern, and fun.
Use standard HTML tags (section, div) for the main layout to allow creative asymmetry. Do NOT wrap the whole page in a standard Shadcn Card.
Implement 'Unbounded' font for headings via Google Fonts in the index.html or global css. Implement 'Manrope' for body.
Use Framer Motion for the hero elements and the floating Mascot.
Build a custom Marquee component using framer-motion or CSS animations to divide the Hero and the Benefits section.
For the Bento Grid, ensure it collapses cleanly to a 1-column stack on mobile (grid-cols-1). On desktop, use varied span sizes to avoid boring uniform squares.
For the Syllabus (10 weeks), use the Shadcn UI Accordion component but strip its default borders and give it a rounded-2xl background (e.g., bg-stone-100) with generous padding.
Never use generic placeholder images. Use the exact URLs provided in the 'image_urls' array.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not center-align the main app container. Left-align text for readability, center only specific hero headlines if visually balanced.
Never apply universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels normal. Generous padding makes the design feel premium.
No emojis as icons. Use Lucide-react.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on headers where content scrolls underneath. Use backdrop-blur-xl + bg-white/80.
Buttons should have modern pill-shaped or rounded-2xl styles with clear hover states.
